close_reason: Test-only code. (&'static str, String) key design works and is type-safe.
description: tests/common/mod.rs Inner uses HashMap<(&'static str, String), …>. Using a heterogeneous pair (&'static str, String) as a composite key mixes lifetime concerns and prevents ergonomic lookup-by-borrow. A cleaner design is a two-level HashMap: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, …>> (type-name outer, account-id inner), which avoids constructing composite keys and makes the structure self-documenting. The current design also requires allocating a String for account_id on every read path (current_state, objects_ref) not just writes.
title: Inner.objects HashMap key lifetime is &'static str but account_id is String
